post.description: Read a tracking domain by ID, including its deletion marker. Requires workspace domain read permission; null can also indicate insufficient access. Pass the workspace slug in the URL and operation arguments inside the JSON body as { args: ... }. Inspect the request schema for required fields and exact identifier formats. This operation is read-only despite using POST. Requires org:workspace_domains:read; insufficient permission returns an access-denied error. An authorized read with no matching resource returns WORKSPACE_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND (404). Only use pagination arguments declared in the schema.
